crossRefs.note: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and…
This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward…
Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,
Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

people.name: Beth-horon_Lower
people.line: Town in Ephraim and Dan, site of a famous battle.

people.name: Beth-horon_Upper
people.line: Town in Ephraim, near Lower Beth-horon.

people.name: Sheerah
people.line: Ephraim's granddaughter who built three towns

people.name: Uzzen-sheerah
people.line: A town built by Sheerah, daughter of Ephraim

translations.web: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
translations.bsb: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.
translations.kjv: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
translations.asv: And his daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth-horon the nether and the upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.
